meta.title: General Automatic Memory
meta.description: Cross-tool, human-editable, self-indexing long-term memory with a fixed token budget.

panel.title: Memory
panel.hostUnavailable: Host routes unavailable. Tools and slash commands still work.

overview.desc: Health, injection cost and everything waiting for you — in one place.
overview.kindDistributionHint: Click a kind to browse it
overview.noAttentionDesc: Budget, index and write queue all look healthy.
overview.undoDesc: The entry moves to the archive with a full audit record. Nothing is hard-deleted.
overview.quickActionsHint: The actions you reach for most
overview.injectionPreviewHint: The exact catalog layer the model sees. Byte stability is what makes prefix cache work.
overview.emptyCatalog: The catalog layer is empty: no always-on or on-demand entries yet.
overview.allClearDesc: No alerts. Injection budget and index are both healthy.

browse.desc: Search, filter and edit long-term memory directly.
browse.noResultsDesc: Try another keyword, or clear kind and scope filters.
browse.emptyDesc: Tell the agent something worth remembering, or import from another tool.

detail.title: Memory detail
detail.invalidateDesc: Invalidation is reversible: the entry moves to the archive with a full audit record.
detail.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. outdated / superseded by a new decision
detail.invalidateHint: The reason goes into the audit trail so future-you can explain the decision.
detail.discardDesc: Leaving now will drop this edit.
detail.markdownHint: Markdown supported; saving rebuilds the index immediately
detail.emptyBodyDesc: Enter edit mode to add content.
detail.rawHint: Raw data is read-only and ready to copy.

import.hint: Bring in memory files and past conversations from other agents. Scan is read-only; a snapshot is taken before applying.
import.scanOnlyHint: Scanning is read-only; applying always snapshots first
import.notDetectedHint: You can still scan the default locations
import.noSourcesDesc: Try another filter, or point at a Markdown directory manually.
import.genericDesc: Scan .md / .markdown / .txt files, review the dry-run, then decide what to import.
import.noItemsDesc: Change the filter or clear the search.
import.confirmDesc: Import is a batch write: a snapshot is created first and can be rolled back as a whole.
import.doneHint: Written and snapshotted. Roll back anytime from Recovery.

confirm.queueDesc: These candidates are not on disk yet. Approve to write; ignoring leaves no memory behind.

timeline.hint: See memories as they were valid on a date (validFrom ≤ date < invalidatedAt) — answers “why did the agent decide that back then”.
timeline.empty: No valid memories on this day
timeline.emptyDesc: Try another date, or jump back to today.

graph.desc: An entity/relation map of memory. Click a node to focus; click a relation to open its source memory.
graph.emptyDesc: Say “X owns Y”; it will appear after import or automatic extraction.
graph.svgLabel: Memory entity graph. Focus nodes to inspect relations, or switch to the list view.

audit.desc: Every read and write, including gated and blocked attempts.
audit.empty: No audit records for this day
audit.emptyDesc: Try another day, or clear the action and keyword filters.

recovery.desc: Snapshots, rollback, checks and export. Every batch operation snapshots first.
recovery.doctorHint: Verifies derived files and index; can auto-repair.
recovery.noSnapshotsDesc: They are created automatically before import, consolidation and restore — or make one now.
recovery.restoreDesc: Current state is snapshotted first, so the restore itself can be undone.
recovery.diffHint: Select two snapshots to see additions, removals and changes
recovery.diffPick: Select one more snapshot to compare.
recovery.exportHint: Exports truth source only; PII is excluded by default.
recovery.exportDialogDesc: A local backup containing truth-source files, the graph and index metadata.
recovery.includePiiHint: Entries with pii: true are excluded by default to keep backups private.
recovery.importZipDesc: Existing files are never overwritten; conflicts stay entry-level decisions.
recovery.importZipHint: A snapshot is created before importing.

settings.hint: Values come from the dsh profile (cordis.patch.yml). This view is read-only; edit in dsh Plugins / Settings.
settings.projectionHint: Export memory into formats other tools read. Off by default — the value is importing in, not sharing out.
settings.projectionReadonly: Toggles live in the profile; this only runs them.
settings.injectionPreviewHint: Exactly what the model sees, byte-stable.
settings.injectionPreviewIdle: Expand to inspect the current injection catalog.
settings.groupIngestHint: Auto-write by default with undo in Overview; switch to suggest to approve first.

command.title: Command palette
command.placeholder: Search memories, jump to a view, or run an action…
command.noResultsDesc: Try another keyword, or use the navigation below.
command.doctorHint: Rebuild derived files and verify the index
command.exportHint: Export a memory zip without PII
